fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (SKHY) is expected to surpass Micron (up 128%) and Sandisk (up 194%) with a 328% revenue increase and 632% operating profit surge in Q3 2026.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix holds 29% DRAM and 19% NAND flash market share, with a 24% premium pricing on HBM4 chips and control of one-third of the global HBM market, positioning it with a $641B market growth opportunity by 2030.
